LanguageData.DMS_Gun_MK44_Autocannon.label: MK44 BushMasterII AutoCannon
LanguageData.DMS_Gun_MK44_Autocannon.description: The MK44 Bushmaster II autocannon is a low-rate-of-fire (200 RPM), high-power, and high-precision weapon. It can be equipped on medium-sized mechanoids and fires 30×173mm NATO ammunition, effectively filling the role of a precision burst-fire autocannon.

LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_RR.label: Airburst canister
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_RR.description: a shaped charge canister that bursts sharp metal darts mid-air. throws a forward cone of darts down the firing line, so it also hurts whatever was standing behind the cover.
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_RR_HE.label: 73mm HE-frag shell
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_RR_HE.description: A thin-cased high explosive shell tuned for area effect rather than penetration. It sweeps a wide circle clear of infantry and light emplacements, but the blast wave spends itself against anything properly armored.
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_RR_Demolition.label: 73mm demolition shell
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_RR_Demolition.description: A heavy demolition shell with a slow, heaving filler and a delayed fuze that lets it seat against the target before it lets go. It is meant for walls, bunkers and load-bearing structures; against personnel it is merely adequate, and its weight costs range.
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_RR_Smoke.label: 73mm airburst smoke shell
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_RR_Smoke.description: A large screening shell with a proximity fuze that opens above head height, laying an obscurant bank far wider than any hand-thrown canister. It does no damage at all; it exists to blind a firing line long enough for an assault or a withdrawal to happen.
